statement: Use "Flush Edits" in undo, redo and data-block housekeeping; the document ends in the state Blender 5.3 produces for the same input and one undo step restores the previous state.

Switch visibility, lock, mute or expansion state in undo, redo and data-block housekeeping with "Toggle Fake User"; the changed state is visible in the UI and the output, it is saved with the document, and one undo step restores it.

Run the data operation "Generate Preview" on the current selection in undo, redo and data-block housekeeping; the resulting data matches Blender 5.3 for the same input, the operation reports a clear error when the input is invalid, and one undo step restores the original.

Run the data operation "Generate Preview from Object" on the current selection in undo, redo and data-block housekeeping; the resulting data matches Blender 5.3 for the same input, the operation reports a clear error when the input is invalid, and one undo step restores the original.

Bring content into the document in undo, redo and data-block housekeeping with "Load Custom Preview"; the content is available afterwards with its values intact, missing or broken sources are reported rather than skipped silently, and one undo step reverts the document.

Switch visibility, lock, mute or expansion state in undo, redo and data-block housekeeping with "Toggle Library Override Editable"; the changed state is visible in the UI and the output, it is saved with the document, and one undo step restores it.

Remove or clear content in undo, redo and data-block housekeeping with "Remove Preview"; the targeted data is gone afterwards, unrelated data is untouched, references to it are left valid, and one undo step restores it.

Remove or clear content in undo, redo and data-block housekeeping with "Unlink Data-Block"; the targeted data is gone afterwards, unrelated data is untouched, references to it are left valid, and one undo step restores it.
Run the action "Redo" in undo, redo and data-block housekeeping; the document or playback state ends as Blender 5.3 leaves it for the same input, and the user can cancel or undo it.
Run the action "Undo" in undo, redo and data-block housekeeping; the document or playback state ends as Blender 5.3 leaves it for the same input, and the user can cancel or undo it.
Run the action "Undo History" in undo, redo and data-block housekeeping; the document or playback state ends as Blender 5.3 leaves it for the same input, and the user can cancel or undo it.
Run the action "Undo Push" in undo, redo and data-block housekeeping; the document or playback state ends as Blender 5.3 leaves it for the same input, and the user can cancel or undo it.
Run the action "Undo and Redo" in undo, redo and data-block housekeeping; the document or playback state ends as Blender 5.3 leaves it for the same input, and the user can cancel or undo it.
